context: Sho and Hina go swimming together.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、泳ぐ、本当、楽しい。
lines.en: Sho, swimming is really so much fun!
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered eight-year-old delight. Open, generous tone with genuine warmth. Light, eager pace. Her voice reaches naturally upward on 'fun'—not performed, just real joy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, steady six-year-old commitment. Soft, genuine tone without strain. Slow, deliberate pace. A small, warm sincerity that asks nothing in return.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、最高、本当に。
lines.en: Together—that's really the best part, truly.
lines.style: High, tender eight-year-old emphasis on togetherness. Gentle, sincere tone with quiet wonder. Slight pause before 'the best'—savoring the moment. Real childish warmth, not performed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm really happy about this, truly.
lines.style: Small, genuine six-year-old happiness. Soft, warm tone. Unhurried pace. The contentment of being included. No performance—just a child saying something true.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Let's try our best together, okay?
lines.style: Bright eight-year-old encouragement. Open, warm tone with gentle conviction. Forward momentum in the delivery. A promise made simply, with childish certainty that matters.
